reflections.summary: Series closed 2-0. The four-mon core (Pelipper/Swampert-Mega/Gholdengo/Incineroar) executed cleanly: Swampert under rain outsped the entire opponent team, Gholdengo's Dazzling Gleam pressured Dragonite and Appletun simultaneously, and the T8 Incineroar switch brought Intimidate to suppress Kingambit while Swampert eliminated Dragonite. The pre-planned T9 double-up (High Horsepower + Close Combat) KO'd Kingambit exactly as calculated. No decision errors recorded; the team-preview plan and Mega Sw
reflections.adjustment: No next game needed — series is over. For future reference: the main risk in this build is relying on rain turns for speed control; against teams with multiple weather setters or priority users, consider preserving Pelipper more aggressively or packing a secondary speed-control option.
reflections.notebook: Series 5ad41de6bc1a: WON 2-0. Opponent roster: Sneasler(Focus Sash/Unburden/Jolly), Kingambit(Black Glasses/Supreme Overlord/Adamant), Dragonite(Sitrus Berry/Multiscale/Jolly), Appletun(Wise Glasses/Thick Fat/Modest), Gengar(Gengarite/Cursed Body→Mega Shadow Tag/Timid), Sinistcha(Leftovers/Heatproof/Bold). Incineroar Intimidate + Close Combat is the ideal Kingambit answer. Mega Swampert rain archetype matched well here.

reflections.summary: Lost on preview. Brought Appletun+Dragonite core that is 2x weak to both of opp's actual spam moves - Mega Swampert Ice Punch and LO Gholdengo Dazzling Gleam - with no Pelipper/water answer. Even with Tailwind up, Appletun was deleted by that spread and Dragonite followed, leaving Kingambit to be cleaned by Incineroar Close Combat + High Horsepower. Sneasler/Appletun bring had no synergy vs rain + Fairy spread.
reflections.adjustment: Drop Appletun completely next game - it is unplayable into Pelipper/Mega Swampert/Gholdengo. Don't pair Dragonite with another Ice/Fairy weak mon. Bring a dedicated Water-resist + Fairy-resist that pressures Pelipper (e.g., Electric/Grass that beats Swampert) and keep Kingambit healthy away from Incineroar CC. Commit to either Tailwind offense or TR counter, not both.
reflections.notebook: Opp core is Pelipper Drizzle + Adamant Mega Swampert + LO Modest Gholdengo + Careful Leftovers Intimidate Incineroar + Scarf Timid Manectric Lightning Rod + Quiet Mental Herb Farigiraf TR. Gameplan is Gholdengo Dazzling Gleam + Swampert Ice Punch spread even after rain ends, Pelipper in back to reset, Incineroar late Intimidate + Close Combat to kill Kingambit.
